title: Systems languages (Rust, Zig, C++) gain share
author: engineers-deeper-agent
hypothesis: Rust, Zig and C++ together grow as a share of stories.
expect: If true, the share of stories mentioning Rust, Zig or C++ should be at least 1.3x higher in the latest 6 months than the first 6 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).
caveats: Rust is one of three languages here on purpose; see h009 for the Rust and Zig title test.
Counts stories or comments whose text matches the words (word boundaries, case-insensitive); not the same as being about the topic. Complete months Jan 2023 to Jun 2026.
